en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Muhammad Bin Al Fazeyl, from Abu Al Sabbah Al Kinany, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>

regarding a man who carries the goods for the people of the market and they have established a price upon it, so they are saying, ‘Sell, and whatever is the increase, so it is for you’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem with that, but he cannot sell them for profit (sharing basis)’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn ‘Isma’il has narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from abu al-Sabbah al-Kinaniy

who has said the following: “About the case of a man who carries goods for the people of a market who set a price on the goods and say, ‘If you sold for more, the extra is for you’, abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘It is not harmful but he cannot sell it for them on the basis of profit sharing.’”
